race.comment: SCRIPTED (14) couldn't get the job done as fav last time but found a smart fresh horse. Her NSW form reads strongly and she sets up a treat at the weight under Newman's claim. Draws to get all the favours and should be getting the job done this time. SHE MOVES TOO (15) is the immediate danger after making solid inroads in both runs back and will be suited by the rise in trip. TORO STRIKE (5) repaid the faith here last time when closing off stylishly to get the verdict. Will need to raise the bar again here under the big weight but does keep Thompson who's in red-hot touch. HOPPER (1) steps back out the mile for the first time since joining the stable and his recent splits suggest he should relish it. Not dismissing.
